title: VDB2 NetherCraft
description: The datapack adds craft to all nether principal itens.
body:
🔥 NetherCraft – Bring the Nether to your workbench! 🔥

NetherCraft is a datapack that adds crafting recipes for all Nether items and mobs, allowing you to access everything this dimension has to offer without having to enter it.

Perfect for servers like VDB2, where the Nether is blocked, but you still need to obtain essential resources such as blaze rods, netherite, quartz, ghast tears, and more.

✨ Key features:



New balanced crafting recipes for every Nether item/mob.

Fully compatible with Minecraft Vanilla.

Ideal for survival servers or hardcore worlds.

Keeps the difficulty balanced, requiring effort to obtain the rarest resources.


🚀 Now, even without exploring the Nether, you can progress in the game and unlock all its secrets!

**VDB2 Creators Official Project**
